items.exampleEn: Our teacher explained how a republic works.
items.exampleZh: 老師解釋了共和國是怎麼運作的。

items.exampleEn: My aunt works for a government bureau.
items.exampleZh: 我阿姨在一個政府機關工作。

items.exampleEn: The northeast of the island has beautiful beaches.
items.exampleZh: 島的東北部有美麗的海灘。

items.exampleEn: The old empire had many great cities.
items.exampleZh: 那個古老的帝國有許多偉大的城市。

items.exampleEn: My father worked as a builder when he was young.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸年輕時當過建築工人。

items.exampleEn: The football academy accepts players from age ten.
items.exampleZh: 這所足球學校收十歲以上的球員。

items.exampleEn: Geography is my favorite subject at school.
items.exampleZh: 地理是我在學校最喜歡的科目。

items.exampleEn: The museum is on Fifth Avenue.

items.sentenceEn: Walk along the avenue until you see the bank.
items.sentenceZh: 沿著大道走，直到看見銀行。

items.audioEn: The tourist bureau opens at nine and gives out free maps of the city.
items.audioZh: 旅遊服務處九點開門，提供免費的市區地圖。

items.sentenceEn: In geography class, we learned about rivers and mountains.
items.sentenceZh: 地理課上，我們學了河流和山脈。

items.sentenceEn: The builders are working on the roof today.
items.sentenceZh: 建築工人今天在修屋頂。

items.stemEn: A country without a king or queen is called a ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有國王或女王的國家稱為共和國。

items.stemEn: My brother wants to study painting at an art ____.
items.stemZh: 我哥哥想在藝術學院學畫畫。

items.passageEn: Nora studies geography at a small academy in the northeast of the city. This summer, she has a part-time job at the tourist bureau on Park Avenue. Visitors often ask her about the old palace, which was built during the time of the empire. Nora tells them that the builders needed forty years to finish it. She also helps tourists find hotels and shows them where to send packages home.
items.passageZh: Nora 在城市東北部的一所小型學院念地理。今年夏天，她在 Park Avenue 上的旅遊服務處打工。遊客常問她那座古老宮殿的事，宮殿是在帝國時期建造的。Nora 告訴他們，建築工人花了四十年才完工。她也幫觀光客找飯店，並告訴他們哪裡可以把包裹寄回家。

questions.questionZh: Nora 今年夏天在哪裡打工？
那座宮殿花了多久才完工？

items.promptZh: 這個帝國延續了三百年。
referenceEn: This empire lasted for three hundred years.
The empire lasted three hundred years.
rubricZh: 時態配合內容（例如說歷史用過去式）

items.promptZh: 這個地區的地理環境很適合種茶。
referenceEn: The geography of this area is good for growing tea.
The geography of this region is perfect for growing tea.
rubricZh: 用 geography 表示「地理（環境）」（例如 the geography of this area）
「很適合」可寫，例如 is good for、is perfect for 等
